verdict.rationale: Authenticating through enterprise SSO or a cloud platform is a fair question for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence shows no SSO, enterprise identity provider, or cloud-platform (e.g. cloud model provider) authentication. The only related items are adjacent: a local access token for the web UI, a generic local provider config file path, and a consumer login that grants free credits. None of these is an enterprise identity or cloud-platform auth integration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
